question: For taxation purposes, an 'Equity Oriented Fund' must invest at least ___% of its assets in domestic equity shares.
hint: Tax benefits के लिए magic number.
explanation: एक fund को Equity Oriented classify किया जाता है यदि उसके investible funds का कम से कम 65% listed companies के domestic equity shares में invested हो।

question: How is 'Dividend' (Income Distribution) from mutual funds taxed in the hands of the investor?
options: Taxed at a flat rate of 10%
Taxed at the investor's applicable income tax slab rate
answer: Taxed at the investor's applicable income tax slab rate
hint: आपकी income में add होता है।
explanation: Dividends investor की total income में add होते हैं और उनके marginal income tax slab के अनुसार taxed होते हैं।

question: Is Dividend Distribution Tax (DDT) applicable to Mutual Funds currently?
explanation: DDT को Finance Act 2020 में abolish कर दिया गया था। अब, tax burden recipient (investor) पर है, न कि mutual fund house पर।

question: The holding period to classify gains from Equity Oriented Funds as 'Long Term' is:
explanation: Equity-oriented funds के लिए, यदि units को 12 months से अधिक समय तक hold किया जाता है, तो gains को Long Term Capital Gains (LTCG) माना जाता है।

question: Short Term Capital Gains (STCG) from Equity Oriented Funds are taxed at:
explanation: Equity funds पर STCG पर income slab के बावजूद concessional rate (आमतौर पर 15%, हाल ही में 2024 budget में बढ़ाकर 20% किया गया) plus cess पर tax लगाया जाता है।

question: Which tax is levied only on redemption/sale of Equity Oriented Mutual Fund units?
explanation: STT (0.001%) equity-oriented mutual fund units के redemption या sale पर applicable है।

question: TDS (Tax Deducted at Source) on dividends is deducted by the AMC for resident investors if the dividend amount exceeds:
explanation: AMCs को 10% पर TDS deduct करना होगा यदि किसी resident investor को financial year में pay किया गया aggregate dividend Rs. 5,000 से अधिक है।

question: For 'Specified Mutual Funds' (Debt funds with < 35% equity), capital gains are taxed as:
options: Short Term Capital Gains (added to income) regardless of holding period
answer: Short Term Capital Gains (added to income) regardless of holding period
explanation: Finance Act 2023 के अनुसार, 35% से कम equity में invest करने वाले funds पर holding period के बावजूद investor के slab rate पर tax लगाया जाता है (इसे Short Term माना जाता है)।

question: Capital Gains from a 'Fund of Funds' (investing in foreign/debt schemes) are generally treated as:
hint: जब तक कि यह domestic ETFs में 90% hold न करे।
explanation: अधिकांश FoFs (जब तक कि वे domestic equity ETFs में 90%+ invest न करें) को taxation के लिए Non-Equity/Debt funds माना जाता है।

question: If an investor sells a Debt Fund unit after holding it for 15 months, the gain is classified as:
explanation: चूँकि holding period 24 months (या specific vintage rules के आधार पर 36 months, लेकिन 15 निश्चित रूप से short है) से कम है, यह STCG है।

question: Can Short Term Capital Loss (STCL) be set off against Long Term Capital Gains (LTCG)?
hint: Short, Long से मिल सकता है।
explanation: Short Term Capital Loss को Short Term Capital Gains और Long Term Capital Gains दोनों के against set off किया जा सकता है।

question: Can Long Term Capital Loss (LTCL) be set off against Short Term Capital Gains (STCG)?
hint: Long केवल Long से मिलता है।
explanation: Long Term Capital Loss को केवल Long Term Capital Gains के against set off किया जा सकता है।

question: Is TDS applicable on Capital Gains for Resident Individual investors?
explanation: Resident individuals के लिए, mutual funds से capital gains पर कोई TDS deduct नहीं किया जाता है। Investor को returns (Advance Tax/Self-Assessment) file करते समय tax pay करना होगा।

question: Is TDS applicable on Capital Gains for NRI investors?
explanation: Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) के लिए, AMC को redemption proceeds pay करने से पहले दोनों capital gains (STCG और LTCG) पर TDS deduct करना required है।

question: The exemption limit for Long Term Capital Gains on Equity Oriented Funds in a financial year is:
explanation: Equity shares/funds से प्रति वर्ष Rs. 1 Lakh (Budget 2024 में बढ़ाकर Rs. 1.25 Lakh) तक के Gains LTCG tax से exempt हैं।

question: Which of the following allows an investor to switch from one scheme to another without immediate tax implication?
options: None of the above (All are taxable events)
answer: None of the above (All are taxable events)
explanation: Current tax laws के तहत, कोई भी switch (STP, Growth से Dividend, Scheme A से Scheme B) एक redemption और purchase माना जाता है, जो capital gains tax attract करता है।

question: If an investor does not provide a PAN, the TDS rate on dividends will be:
explanation: यदि PAN furnish नहीं किया जाता है, तो TDS 20% (Section 206AA) के higher penal rate पर deduct किया जाता है।

question: Indexation benefit is generally associated with:
explanation: Indexation purchase price को inflation के लिए adjust करने की अनुमति देता है। Historically, यह Debt funds पर LTCG पर लागू होता था (हालाँकि recent changes ने कई categories के लिए इसे restrict कर दिया है)।

question: To claim the benefit of 'Grandfathering' for LTCG on equity (gains before 31st Jan 2018), one needs:
options: Fair Market Value (FMV) as of 31st Jan 2018
answer: Fair Market Value (FMV) as of 31st Jan 2018
explanation: 31st Jan 2018 तक accrued Gains grandfathering clause के तहत exempt हैं, जो उस date पर FMV का उपयोग करके calculate किए जाते हैं।

question: Cost Inflation Index (CII) numbers are notified by:
explanation: CBDT indexed cost of acquisition calculate करने के लिए प्रत्येक financial year में CII notify करता है।

question: Which form does an investor receive from the AMC for TDS deducted?
explanation: Form 16A salary के अलावा अन्य income (जैसे dividends/interest) के लिए issue किया जाने वाला TDS certificate है।

question: To avoid TDS on dividends, a resident senior citizen (above 60) can submit:
explanation: Senior citizens यह declare करने के लिए Form 15H submit करते हैं कि उनकी total income taxable limit से नीचे है।

question: To avoid TDS on dividends, a resident individual (below 60) can submit:
explanation: Form 15G 60 वर्ष से कम आयु के individuals के लिए self-declaration form है ताकि यदि income exemption limit से नीचे है तो TDS deduction को रोका जा सके।

question: A 'balanced fund' with 60% equity and 40% debt is treated for tax purposes as:
explanation: चूँकि equity exposure 65% से कम है, यह Equity Oriented Fund definition में fail हो जाता है और इस पर Non-Equity (Debt) fund के रूप में tax लगता है।

question: Capital gains arising from the switch of units from Regular Plan to Direct Plan are:
options: Taxed only if exit load applies
explanation: Switch legally एक scheme/plan से redemption और दूसरे का purchase है। Redemption पर realized gains taxable हैं।

question: ELSS (Equity Linked Savings Scheme) offers tax deduction under which section?
explanation: ELSS investments Rs. 1.5 Lakh तक Income Tax Act के Section 80C के तहत deduction के लिए qualify करते हैं।

question: Are dividends received from mutual funds taxable if the amount is less than Rs. 5,000?
options: Yes, they are always taxable in the hands of the investor
Only if investor is in highest bracket
answer: Yes, they are always taxable in the hands of the investor
explanation: Dividends हमेशा taxable income होते हैं। Rs. 5,000 limit केवल TDS deduction के लिए है। भले ही आपको Rs. 100 मिले, आपको इसे अपनी taxable income में add करना होगा।

question: If an investor incurs a Capital Loss, can they carry it forward to future years?
explanation: यदि Income Tax Return समय पर file किया जाता है तो Capital losses को 8 assessment years के लिए carry forward किया जा सकता है।

question: Which of these funds does NOT attract STT?
explanation: STT केवल equity-oriented funds पर लागू होता है। Debt funds (जैसे Liquid Funds) STT से exempt हैं।

question: The rate of TDS on capital gains for NRIs for Short Term Equity is:
hint: Tax rate से match करता है।
explanation: NRIs के लिए TDS gain पर applicable tax rate से match करता है। STCG Equity के लिए, यह आमतौर पर 15% (या prevailing rate) होता है।

question: Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (DTAA) benefits are available to:
hint: दो देशों में tax avoid करना।
explanation: NRIs lower TDS rates claim कर सकते हैं यदि India का उनके residence country के साथ DTAA है, जो Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) submit करने के अधीन है।

question: Bonus units issued by a mutual fund are:
options: Not taxable at the time of allotment
answer: Not taxable at the time of allotment
explanation: Bonus units का allotment taxable event नहीं है। हालाँकि, future sale पर gains calculate करते समय उनकी cost of acquisition zero मानी जाती है।

question: Tax Saving (ELSS) funds have a mandatory lock-in period of:
explanation: ELSS में सभी Section 80C investment options में सबसे छोटा lock-in period (3 years) है।

question: Arbitrage Funds are treated for tax purposes as:
hint: वे hedge करने के लिए equity का उपयोग करते हैं।
explanation: चूँकि arbitrage funds predominantly equity और equity derivatives (>65%) में invest करते हैं, वे equity taxation benefits enjoy करते हैं।

question: Set-off of Capital Losses is allowed against Salary Income. True or False?
explanation: Capital losses को income के किसी अन्य head (जैसे Salary या House Property) के against set off नहीं किया जा सकता है, केवल Capital Gains के against किया जा सकता है।

question: Who is responsible for paying the tax on Capital Gains?
explanation: Residents के लिए, AMC redemption proceeds full (कोई TDS नहीं) pay करता है, और investor tax calculate करने और pay करने के लिए responsible होता है।

question: The 'Cost of Acquisition' for bonus units is considered to be:
options: The NAV on the bonus date
explanation: चूँकि investor ने bonus units के लिए कुछ pay नहीं किया, इसलिए capital gains calculation के लिए उनकी acquisition cost zero ली जाती है।

question: GST is applicable on:
options: The exit load and management fees
answer: The exit load and management fees
explanation: GST (18%) provided services पर charge किया जाता है, यानी Exit Load और Management Fees (TER)।

question: A SIP transaction is treated as:
options: A single investment on the start date
Multiple separate investments, each with its own holding period
answer: Multiple separate investments, each with its own holding period
explanation: प्रत्येक SIP installment एक fresh purchase है। Sell करते समय, holding period की calculation प्रत्येक unit के लिए individually (First-In-First-Out) की जाती है।

question: Surcharge and Cess are levied:
options: Over and above the Income Tax payable
answer: Over and above the Income Tax payable
explanation: Health & Education Cess (4%) और applicable Surcharge basic income tax liability में add किए जाते हैं।

question: Which of the following is NOT a 'Capital Asset' for tax purposes?
explanation: Trader द्वारा hold किए गए Stock in trade को business inventory माना जाता है, और profits 'Business Income' होते हैं, 'Capital Gains' नहीं।

question: For a Dividend Reinvestment Plan, the reinvested dividend is:
options: Taxable in the hands of the investor
answer: Taxable in the hands of the investor
explanation: भले ही reinvest किया गया हो, dividend legally investor को pay किया जाता है और तुरंत new units खरीदने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है। यह taxable income है।

question: If shares/units are gifted to a relative (defined list), the tax implication for the recipient is:
explanation: Specified relatives (parents, spouse, siblings, आदि) से प्राप्त Gifts recipient के हाथों में tax से exempt हैं।

question: For tax purposes, international funds (investing >65% in foreign stocks) are treated as:
explanation: 'Equity Oriented' definition के लिए *domestic* companies में 65% की आवश्यकता होती है। Foreign funds इसमें fail हो जाते हैं और उन पर debt funds के रूप में tax लगता है।

question: If an investor earns Rs. 4,000 dividend in a year, will TDS be deducted?
explanation: चूँकि amount <= Rs. 5,000 है, कोई TDS deduct नहीं किया जाता है (residents के लिए)।

question: Which method is used to determine which units are sold first for tax calculation?
explanation: Mutual funds के लिए, capital gains calculate करने के लिए First-In-First-Out (FIFO) method mandatory है।

question: The STT rate for equity mutual fund redemption is:
explanation: Equity MF units के sale पर Securities Transaction Tax 0.001% है।

question: Are 'Switch' transactions reported in the Capital Gains Statement (AIS/TIS)?
explanation: चूँकि switches redemptions हैं, AMCs उन्हें Income Tax Department को report करते हैं, और वे investor के AIS (Annual Information Statement) में दिखाई देते हैं।

question: If a minor earns capital gains from mutual funds gifted by parents, the income is:
options: Clubbed with the income of the parent earning higher income
answer: Clubbed with the income of the parent earning higher income
explanation: Minor की passive income को उस parent की income के साथ club किया जाता है जिसकी total income अधिक है।

question: Section 54F offers exemption on Capital Gains if the proceeds are invested in:
explanation: Section 54F non-residential assets (जैसे funds) से LTCG की exemption की अनुमति देता है यदि net consideration का उपयोग residential house खरीदने/बनाने के लिए किया जाता है।
